name: Four-cycle-free edge sets of the 7-dimensional hypercube
description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of Q7 (vertices 0..127, endpoints differing in one bit). No 2-dimensional face may have all four edges selected. Maximize the number of edges (Q7 has 448). An edge set with m edges certifies ex(Q7,C4) >= m; 304 is the best known and 308 the best upper bound.
